zh: 3 和 5 互素，“同时被 3 和 5 整除”等价于“被 15 整除”，所以要先判断 15，再分别判断 3 和 5。
依次判断：被 15 整除输出 FizzBuzz；否则被 3 整除输出 Fizz；否则被 5 整除输出 Buzz；否则输出数字本身。这几个分支互斥，每个整数恰好输出一行。
从 1 循环到 N，按上面的顺序生成每一行；N 接近 2×10^6，输出约 13MB，应该把所有行写进一个大缓冲区后一次性输出，而不是每行都刷新输出流。
en: 3 and 5 are coprime, so being divisible by both is the same as being divisible by 15; check 15 first, then 3 and 5 separately.

Check in order: divisible by 15 prints FizzBuzz; otherwise divisible by 3 prints Fizz; otherwise divisible by 5 prints Buzz; otherwise print the number itself. The branches are mutually exclusive, so each integer produces exactly one line.

Loop from 1 to N and build each line in that order; N is close to 2*10^6 and the output is about 13 MB, so write all lines into one large buffer and output it at once instead of flushing the stream on every line.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Classify each integer by divisibility by 15, 3 and 5 in that priority; merge every 8192 lines into one string block, and finally join the blocks for the return value, so that nearly two million separate string objects are never held at once.

## Proof of correctness

3 and 5 are coprime, so being divisible by both is equivalent to being divisible by 15. Once 15 is handled first, the following 3 and 5 branches are mutually exclusive and match the requirement of dividing only one of them; the last branch is exactly the case of dividing neither. The integers are traversed in increasing order and each is output once; the blocking only changes how the output is buffered, not the order of the lines.

## Complexity

O(N + output bytes) time and an O(output bytes) output buffer, with only about 8192 short-line objects; the largest valid output, including the final newline, is 13140738 bytes, and the output limit is configured at 16 MiB.
